technical_quality: Adequate: good inspiration (posterior ribs 9-10 visible), no significant rotation (clavicular heads symmetric about the spinous processes), adequate penetration with vertebral bodies faintly visible behind the heart; left-side lead marker with position indicator in the image's upper right corner confirms conventional orientation. Breast shadows overlie both lower zones.

devices.type: External lead side marker ('L' with circular position/upright indicator and technologist initials)
devices.location: Image upper right corner, i.e. over the patient's left shoulder region, outside the thorax

abnormalities.finding: Incidental ~1 cm round soft-tissue-density opacity surrounded by gas within the gastric fundus bubble, most consistent with gastric contents (food/tablet); not a pulmonary or pleural lesion
abnormalities.zone: subdiaphragmatic (left upper quadrant, below the lower zone)

description_zh: PA 正面胸部X光，吸氣充分、無明顯旋轉，左側標記位於影像右上方，為傳統擺位。兩側肺野清晰，未見實質浸潤、結節、肋膜積液或氣胸，雙側肋膈角銳利；心臟大小與縱膈輪廓正常，氣管居中，肺門無異常。雙側乳房陰影重疊於下肺野，左側橫膈下胃泡內可見一約 1 公分之圓形軟組織密度影，應為胃內容物，屬偶然發現。未見任何管路、導線或植入裝置，亦無治療痕跡。
